preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 10 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(s) <= 100000 for s in [line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:T+1]])
preconditions.description: Each string s has length between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s) for s in [line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:T+1]])
preconditions.description: Each string s consists only of lowercase letters (a-z).

postconditions.expression: stdout == '\n'.join(str(sum(len(s) - len(p) + 1 for p in substrings(s) if p != '')) for s in [line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:T+1]])
postconditions.description: For each string s, the output is the sum over all nonempty substrings p of s of the number of occurrences of p in s.
Each output line is an integer representing the self-similarity of the corresponding input string.
